title: Groom and Bride Wedding Line
author: EmZone
description:
Embellish your fabrics with this Groom and Bride Wedding Line embroidery design! Perfect for adding a touch of whimsy charm, this design can be stitched onto t-shirt, towels, pillows, home decor items, or any fabric project that needs a little extra flair.
This machine’s Groom and Bride Wedding Line embroidery design is versatile and user-friendly, coming with multiple embroidery file formats to ensure compatibility with a wide range of embroidery machines
